GEVO-9.rationale: Wind generators of 5.0 MW nameplate that are operating or planned to come online H1 2020 must be reported on EIA Form 860 by the operator (City of Luverne or Juhl-affiliate). Absence in 2019 or 2020 EIA-860 of any wind project near Luverne MN at the claimed scale would contradict the wind-PPA claim.
GEVO-9.note: score UNVERIFIABLE; connector not yet built

creative_extensions.claim_text: Gevo owns and operates an isobutanol/ethanol production facility in Luverne, Minnesota with a 1.5 MGPY isobutanol production line (~265,000 gallon fermenter scale) and 22 MGPY ethanol capacity on ~55
creative_extensions.source_label: EPA TRI / GHGRP facility lookup at Luverne, MN
creative_extensions.endpoint_or_method: https://enviro.epa.gov/efservice/ — TRI_FACILITY/CITY_NAME/Luverne/STATE_ABBR/MN and GHG/GHG_FACILITY/CITY_NAME/Luverne/STATE_ABBR/MN
creative_extensions.rationale: A 22 MGPY corn-ethanol plant should report fermentation emissions / chemical releases (VOCs, ethanol vent loss, NOx from boilers). Cross-checks claim of operating biofuel facility at that address.
creative_extensions.expected_observable: TRI release reports and/or GHGRP CO2e reports for Agri-Energy LLC or Gevo at Luverne, MN parcel
creative_extensions.signal_direction: Presence corroborates operating facility; total absence at the operating-volume claimed is a divergence (CLAIMED_LOCATION_GAP)

creative_extensions.claim_text: Gevo owns and operates an isobutanol/ethanol production facility in Luverne, Minnesota with a 1.5 MGPY isobutanol production line (~265,000 gallon fermenter scale) and 22 MGPY ethanol capacity on ~55
creative_extensions.source_label: Minnesota Pollution Control Agency air-quality permit registry
creative_extensions.endpoint_or_method: https://www.pca.state.mn.us/data-and-reports/permits — search facility=Agri-Energy / Luverne
creative_extensions.rationale: State air permits required for fermentation+distillation operations; Minnesota-issued Title V or synthetic-minor permits would directly evidence operating biofuel plant
creative_extensions.expected_observable: Active air-emissions permit + permittee name + permit class
creative_extensions.signal_direction: Active permit corroborates operating facility; lapsed/non-existent permit at scale claimed contradicts

creative_extensions.claim_text: Gevo owns and operates an isobutanol/ethanol production facility in Luverne, Minnesota with a 1.5 MGPY isobutanol production line (~265,000 gallon fermenter scale) and 22 MGPY ethanol capacity on ~55

creative_extensions.claim_text: Gevo entered 2019 supply agreements aggregating approximately 17 MGPY of ATJ + renewable isooctane + other renewable hydrocarbons (with Delta, SAS, Air Total, HCS), all contingent on completing Expand
creative_extensions.source_label: Operational-capacity scaling check vs current EPA-permitted output
creative_extensions.endpoint_or_method: Cross-reference Luverne facility's EPA TRI/GHGRP permitted throughput (from claim GEVO-1) against the implied 17 MGPY hydrocarbons + 10 MGPY Delta volume; the 100,000 gpy current capacity = 170x scale-up requirement
creative_extensions.rationale: Operational-capacity check: the gap between currently-operating capacity and contracted offtake is a quantitative stage-jump risk that compounds the going-concern signal — testable without forward-looking knowledge
creative_extensions.expected_observable: Implied scale-up multiplier
creative_extensions.signal_direction: If currently-permitted output << 1/10th of contracted volume AND financing for expansion not closed, claim becomes 'planned' not 'committed'

creative_extensions.claim_text: Gevo entered 2019 supply agreements aggregating approximately 17 MGPY of ATJ + renewable isooctane + other renewable hydrocarbons (with Delta, SAS, Air Total, HCS), all contingent on completing Expand

creative_extensions.expected_observable: Modification application filed before 2020-09-01
creative_extensions.signal_direction: Filed = construction credibly proximate; not filed = pre-construction stage
